games.name: Anchor Drop
games.description: Guess the ocean word letter by letter before the anchor bonks the sleepy octopus.

games.name: Coral Breaker
games.description: Slide your paddle, bounce the pearl and smash through reefs of coral. Grab power-ups, clear every level.

games.name: Shell Checkers
games.description: Classic draughts on a sandy beach. Jump shells, chain captures and crown your way across.

games.name: Net Weaver
games.description: Take turns tying rope between knots. Close a square to catch a fish and go again. Most fish wins.

games.name: Echo Shells
games.description: Four singing shells hum a growing tune. Listen, then echo it back. How long can you go?

games.name: Eel
games.description: Swipe to steer a hungry eel through the deep. Gulp glowing plankton, grow longer, and never bite your tail.

games.name: Four Fathoms
games.description: Drop pearls into the deep. Line up four — across, down or diagonal — before your rival does.

games.name: Fleet Sonar
games.description: Hide your fleet, then ping the dark water to find theirs. Sink all five ships before they sink yours.

games.name: Puck Splash
games.description: Slap the puck across a slick ice rink! Play the computer or a friend on one phone — first to 7 goals wins.

games.name: Pearl Merge
games.description: Swipe the lagoon to bump matching shells together. They grow into pearls, from grain of sand to sea crown.

games.name: Sea Mines
games.description: Sweep the bay with number clues and flag every hidden mine. Your first tap is always safe.

games.name: Tidepool Pairs
games.description: Flip the tidepool cards and match every sea creature. Fewer flips, faster time, more points.

games.name: Reef Putt
games.description: Nine mini-golf holes on a coral reef. Bank off rocks, dodge the puffer, keep out of the lagoon.

games.name: Flip Reef
games.description: Trap your rival's discs between yours to flip the reef your colour. Most discs at the end wins.

games.name: Wave Rider
games.description: Surf an endless wave! Tap to hop, hold to fly higher, dodge rocks and jellyfish, and scoop up shells.

games.name: Slide Pool
games.description: Slide the tiles back into place to rebuild a sunset sea scene. Or switch to numbers for a classic challenge.

games.name: Sandbar Solitaire
games.description: Classic seven-column patience on a sunny sandbar. Draw 1 or 3, tap to move, undo anytime.

games.name: Reef Stack
games.description: Little coral pieces sink into a 9-wide reef. Fill rows to clear them, and drop pearl bombs to blast a 3×3 hole.

games.name: Sudoku Sands
games.description: Fresh number puzzles on warm beach sand, each with one true answer. Notes, hints and undo included.

games.name: Tide Tac
games.description: Shells versus starfish on a sandy 3×3. Three in a row takes the tide.

games.name: Volley Bay
games.description: Beach-ball paddle duel on the sand. Beat the computer or a friend on the same phone — first to 7 wins.

games.name: Kelp Words
games.description: Hunt for ocean words hidden every which way in the kelp. Drag across the letters to catch them.
